payload.core_mechanism_summary: Reads ratings, flags if any changed. If not, sorts a copy descending and compares to original to determine 'maybe' or 'unrated'.
payload.rationale: The solution uses sorting to check if ratings were originally non-increasing; among provided subtype options, sorting_custom_key is the closest, though no explicit key function is used. The core logic is sorting-based, not sweep line or binary search.
